name: Mark Reeves
quality: low resolution: the Herald ran it as a 180x260 column mugshot; no larger file exists on the site
why: the only photograph of him on wkuherald.com, and it is a straight smiling portrait rather than a group frame
identification: Mugshot attached to his signed commentary of 25 Feb 2014 on WKU budget and athletic spending. The Herald's SGA reports of 5 and 6 Feb 2014 name Executive Vice President Mark Reeves speaking on the same state budget cuts in the same weeks, so the byline portrait and the SGA officer are the same person.

name: Seth Church
why: a straight cap-and-gown graduation portrait, single subject, facing camera; the best frame of him the Herald holds
caption_quote: Seth Church at the 2015 Lavender Graduation ceremony.
identification: Sole subject of the frame and named in the caption. The Herald called him 'Glasgow sophomore Seth Church, chief justice' on 9 Apr 2013, so a 2015 graduation fits; the 2023 alumni feature the picture ran with describes his upbringing 'in rural Kentucky on a farm'.

name: Michael Shelton
quality: a working photograph, not a portrait: he is reading and his hand rests on his cheek, though the face is unobstructed and sharp
why: the only photograph of him on wkuherald.com and it is a clean single-subject frame taken in his first SGA year
caption_quote: Owensboro sophomore Michael Shelton reads inside the $100 Solution House, where he lives.
identification: Only person in the frame and named in the caption. The same paper reports 'Michael Shelton, Owensboro sophomore and resident at the $100 Solution House' on 3 May 2016 and 'Michael Shelton, co-chairman of MyCampusToo' on 4 Feb 2016, tying the hometown and residence in the caption to the SGA officer.

name: Cody Cox
id_confidence: inferred - editor should confirm before publishing
why: a lit studio portrait, single subject, by far the best-quality frame of anyone in this block
caption_quote: Winchester freshman Cody Cox came out of the closet when he was a junior in high school.
identification: Sole subject of a studio portrait, named in the caption. NOT independently tied to SGA: the Herald never gives the SGA chief justice a hometown or class year. The link is name plus timeline - a freshman in Feb 2014 is a junior in 2015-16 (associate justice) and a senior in 2016-17 (chief justice), which is exactly the span recorded for him. Reject if a second Cody Cox at WKU can be shown.

name: Emily Houston

name: Travis Taylor
